source: l2jmobius GeoEngine.loadRegion (new Region(LITTLE_ENDIAN)) + Region.getNearestZ/getNextLowerZ/getNextHigherZ/checkNearestNswe; block type via IBlock classes (FlatBlock, ComplexBlock, MultilayerBlock)
note: geo_x and geo_y are global geo cell coordinates. worldZ is one of -16000, -2000, 0, 2000, 16000 (z_source fixed) or the cell's own nearest Z at worldZ 0 (z_source own_nearest). block_type: 0 flat, 1 complex, 2 multilayer. nswe.* are checkNearestNswe for single directions. seed = 20260401 + regionX * 100 + regionY; the same samples are used for both sets.
